title: The country that measures happiness
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Can a country really measure happiness in a meaningful way?
Which should matter more in national policy: economic growth or people's reported wellbeing?
What questions would you include in a national happiness survey?
Could governments misuse happiness statistics to make life look better than it really is?
What does your country do that you think increases or reduces everyday wellbeing?
